notes: One typescript sheet, with handwritten pagination - 7 - and archive number 71. No title or date is present. Four typed entries concern pages 25–28: a requested hint; a question about characterizing a homomorphism, qualified by a typed interlinear parenthesis; two requested wording changes; and a missing Abhyankar bibliography reference. A handwritten call and footnote ask whether 7.2 generalizes; the x/se form remains an editorial uncertainty, distinct from the author’s written question mark. The insertion connector is present and is reproduced. Two detached dark lobes with a small satellite in the lower-right blank area have uncertain material origin and function; their shapes are preserved without assuming punctuation. No visible cancellation was found. Large faint reverse-side impressions and paper blemishes are not treated as authored text. H supplies description only, so h_reading is null and all diff_h values are false: H is unavailable as a transcription witness. No proof or mathematical computation was checked.
math_reading_decisions: The reference fields p.25, li.10; p.26, li.10; p.27, li.1 et 2; p.28; and (7.17.4.1) were read component by component. Their baseline alignment, regular spacing, repeated serif 1 forms, matching curved 2 forms, and repeated 7 impressions support typewriter construction. No reference digit was reclassified as handwritten merely for being curved.

The inserted S is an ordinary single typed capital with one continuous curved outline. The final s is a separate ordinary typed lower-case letter. The insertion text, its parentheses, and i.e. punctuation are typed; the line below it is handwritten.
The two footnote calls have a raised small 1 inside pen-drawn parentheses. The handwritten note’s 7.2 consists of a crossed 7, a low point, and a curved 2; all are part of the handwritten note.

The C-context au-dessus/au dessus target is confirmed: a short typewriter hyphen stands between au and dessus in the first quotation, while a blank space separates the two words in the second. Both are retained exactly.
Both ellipses consist of three low typewriter points before the elevated closing quotation pair. The first entry has a question mark following that pair; the p.26 quotation is followed by a colon.

The C-context wording, accents, abbreviations, paragraph endings, and Abhyankar reference were checked against half a. The handwritten page numeral and the archive number were also independently inspected; the former has the additional flanking strokes recorded in B072-01.
No factual or proof verification was performed. The mathematical prose is transcribed as the page’s questions and editorial requests.
